user.title: DishWish
user.description: Set up DishWish (recipes, meal wishes and shopping list).

data_description.default_shopping_list: To-do list that ingredients are added to.
data_description.default_servings: Servings used for imported recipes without a yield.

add_to_shopping_list.name: Add recipe to shopping list
add_to_shopping_list.description: Adds the (scaled) ingredients of a recipe to a to-do list. Items already on the list are skipped.

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: Scale the ingredients to this number of servings. Defaults to the recipe's servings.

entity_id.name: To-do list
entity_id.description: Target list. Defaults to the list set in the integration options.

add_open_wishes_to_shopping_list.name: Add open wishes to shopping list
add_open_wishes_to_shopping_list.description: Merges the ingredients of all recipes with open wishes and adds them to a to-do list.

entity_id.name: To-do list
entity_id.description: Target list. Defaults to the list set in the integration options.

entity_not_found.message: No valid to-do list selected. Choose one in the call or in the integration options.

database_corrupt.title: DishWish database is damaged
database_corrupt.description: The integrity check of the DishWish database failed. The integration was not started to protect your data. Restore a backup of `{path}`.
